cards.d: If someone is adept at something, they are very good at doing it.
cards.e: The carpenter is very adept at building houses.
cards.ielts: Young people are often more adept at using new technology than their parents, so they can help older relatives get online.

cards.d: If land is barren, it has no plants growing on it.
cards.e: People cannot farm in barren lands.
cards.ielts: Overgrazing and deforestation have turned large areas of once fertile land into barren desert.

cards.d: If something is ceramic, it is made of baked clay.
cards.e: The house’s roof was made of ceramic tiles.
cards.ielts: Traditional ceramic plates from Rishton are popular souvenirs among tourists visiting Uzbekistan.

cards.d: If something is culinary, it is related to cooking.
cards.e: I gained culinary skills after working in a restaurant for many years.
cards.ielts: Many young people now attend culinary courses, hoping to turn their love of cooking into a successful career.

cards.d: If something is dense, it has a lot of things close together.
cards.e: I easily became lost in the dense forest.
cards.ielts: Densely populated cities need efficient public transport to prevent constant traffic jams.

cards.d: Dignity is the ability to be calm and worthy of respect.
cards.e: When his company went out of business, he faced it with dignity.
cards.ielts: A good welfare system should allow unemployed people to live with dignity while they look for new work.

cards.d: To dominate someone or something is to control them.
cards.e: The loud man dominated the conversation.
cards.ielts: A few large technology companies dominate the global market, making it difficult for small start-ups to compete.

cards.d: If something is edible, you can eat it.
cards.e: We learn about edible plants when we go camping.
cards.ielts: Some schools have created edible gardens, where children grow vegetables and learn about healthy eating.

cards.d: If someone is hostile, they are angry and unfriendly.
cards.e: We were happy to move away from our hostile neighbor.
cards.ielts: Some immigrants face hostile attitudes from local residents, which makes it harder for them to integrate.

cards.d: Your intake of food is the amount of food you take into your body.
cards.e: The doctor said I needed to increase my intake of fruits and vegetables.
cards.ielts: Reducing salt intake is one of the simplest ways to lower the risk of heart disease and stroke.

cards.d: If someone does something likewise, they do the same thing as someone else.
cards.e: If Joe is staying away from school to go swimming, I want to do likewise.
cards.ielts: Parents should limit their own screen time, and teachers should likewise set a good example in the classroom.

cards.d: Malnutrition is the condition of not getting enough nutrients.
cards.e: After eating only a meager amount of food, she suffered from malnutrition.
cards.ielts: Malnutrition remains a leading cause of child deaths in parts of sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia.

cards.d: Medication is medicine or drugs given to people who are sick.
cards.e: The doctor gave me medication to treat my illness.
cards.ielts: In many countries, older people take several kinds of medication each day, which places pressure on health budgets.

cards.d: A misconception is a wrong idea about something.
cards.e: People once believed the misconception that the Earth is flat.
cards.ielts: A common misconception is that recycling alone can solve the problem of plastic waste.

cards.d: If something is obscure, it is not well-known.
cards.e: The old man travels the world in search of obscure books.
cards.ielts: The internet allows obscure musicians from small towns to reach audiences all over the world.

cards.d: To oppress someone means to rule over them in a cruel and unfair way.
cards.e: Free speech had been oppressed in his country.
cards.ielts: Throughout history, authoritarian regimes have oppressed minorities and silenced journalists who criticised them.

cards.d: To peel fruits and vegetables is to remove their skin.
cards.e: We peeled the apple before eating it.
cards.ielts: Factories that peel and package vegetables produce huge amounts of food waste, which could be turned into animal feed.

cards.d: A prescription is permission from a doctor to get medicine.
cards.e: The doctor gave me a prescription for my medication.
cards.ielts: In some countries, antibiotics are sold without a prescription, which contributes to the spread of drug-resistant bacteria.

cards.d: A respirator is a machine that helps weak or sick people breathe.
cards.e: The man needed a respirator to breathe.
cards.ielts: During the pandemic, many hospitals did not have enough respirators for all the patients who needed them.

cards.d: To strive is to struggle to achieve something.
cards.e: People who strive to succeed often do.
cards.ielts: Schools should strive to give every child, regardless of background, an equal chance of success.
